name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Power
tagline: A peanut butter cup you can drink, with 50 g of protein.
steps: Add the liquids to the blender first, then the soft ingredients, powders and frozen ingredients last.
Blend on high for 45–60 seconds until completely smooth.
Taste, adjust thickness with a splash of liquid or a few ice cubes, and serve.
whyItWorks: Powdered peanut butter keeps the peanut flavor with about 85% less fat than regular peanut butter, so protein makes up nearly half the calories. Greek yogurt adds slow-digesting casein and the frozen banana supplies carbs to refill energy after training.

Swap Greek yogurt for silken tofu and use plant protein to make it dairy-free.
